name: swinging-door
prompt: Make a door 0.9 m wide, 2 m tall and 0.05 m thick that is hinged at its left edge and swings open 90 degrees over 1.5 seconds, then stays open.

name: spinning-fan
prompt: Make a fan: a thin bar 1 m long, 0.1 m wide and 0.02 m thick that spins around its centre once per second, forever.

name: bobbing-lamp
prompt: Make a ball of radius 0.2 m that bobs up and down by 0.3 m every two seconds, smoothly, and keeps going.

name: pulsing-cube
prompt: Make a 0.5 m cube that grows to 1.5 times its size and back every second, and also turns a full circle around the vertical axis every four seconds.
